column1: # vibejuel1651 key: the NEW alphabet ("ny Alphabet") of Peder Vibe's letters to Peder Juel, 1651-1655 (Rigsarkivet, TKUA Sverige,
# unit 261583, images 77-93), CC BY 4.0 (Brice Dudout, Europe chiffree, 2026; PR #410).
# Recovered from the letters themselves: the partial interlinear decipherment of the time on N. 319 (image 78) gave the system
# and the opener table; the rest was read with it. Vibe announces the new alphabet in clear on image 62 (11 Jan 1649): "dett ny
# Alphabet" is to follow. The old cipher he used until then has its own key in targets/vibejuel1649/key.tsv.
# A cipher word = OPENER + BODY. The opener (first number, 1-3 or 24-39) gives a shift k; each body number n stands for the letter
# of rank n - k (1-based, not cyclic). In the body, 32/33/34 stand for 1/2/3.
#   25 letters a ... u w x y z oe (w = 21, x = 22, y = 23, z = 24, oe = 25), i = j.
#   Opener table (the same in every letter read): 24-29 -> 0; 30-34 -> 1; 35-39 -> 2; 1-3 -> 3.
#   A word may be split in pieces, each with its own opener (eders = 3.8.7 + 30.6.18.19).
# Nomenclator: two- to four-digit numbers between the words (49 different ones in these letters; in 1655 up to 1771). None is
#   identified by any key; none occurs in the old-cipher letters. Two are defined in clear by Vibe (image 80, 6 Jan 1653): "sub N
#   349" and "N 561" are to be added to the cipher; the names that follow are hard to read (Wranghel? and Wranghel's mother?), so
#   they are given here as probable only and are not used in the reading.
# Columns: section, cipher (letter value at k = 0, or opener range), value, note.
